summary: A full-screen Go terminal app on Bubble Tea with keyboard navigation, styled screens and rendered frames checked against snapshots.
description: Start a Go terminal app that takes over the window, built on Bubble Tea with Bubbles components and Lip Gloss styles. A task list loads in the background, filters as you type and opens into a detail screen. Tests send key presses to the model and compare each screen with a saved golden frame, and the binary prints text or JSON when no terminal is attached, so scripts and coding agents can run it. Replace the task list with your own data and screens.
seoDescription: A Go terminal UI recipe on Bubble Tea with Bubbles and Lip Gloss, golden-frame tests and a text or JSON fallback when no terminal is attached.

projectExamples.title: Log browser for a local service
projectExamples.description: Load log lines from a file in a command, show them in a filterable list, and open one entry with its fields on a detail screen.

plain.whatItIs: A starter for an interactive program that fills the terminal window, written in the Go language, where people move around with the keyboard.
goodAt: Browsing and filtering lists of records from the keyboard
Tools that switch between several screens in one terminal window
Printing the same data as plain text when run in a script
notGoodAt: Commands that just take options, print a result and exit; choose go-cli.
Apps with windows and mouse-driven buttons; choose a desktop stack.

requests: build a full-screen terminal app in Go with keyboard navigation
a Bubble Tea app with a filterable list and a detail view
check every rendered TUI screen against a saved golden frame
an interactive TUI that still prints JSON when its output is piped
caveats: The full-screen interface needs a real terminal; without one the binary prints text or JSON instead.
